mission: Build an evidence-driven, provider-aware, scalable and increasingly autonomous global collectibles intelligence operating system under the 120 Standard.
operating_flow: lawful empirical ER + lawful collector-market evidence
operating_principles: One Program. One Language. One Registry. One Source of Truth.
Generate, validate, approve and publish are separate responsibilities.
Structure is stable; intelligence is dynamic.
Current measurements describe current observability, not permanent superiority.
Portal and IH-EOS consume approved Projection truth.
Track D makes approved intelligence operational and does not approve Production.
Fail closed on incomplete evidence, rights, contracts, lineage, approvals or rollback.
Production/G5 requires explicit Program Owner approval.
